goal: Add accessible note previews and durable drag-to-canvas reference nodes without copying source note bodies.
non_goals: Do not implement Task 9 rich-media ingestion or later AI, retrieval, credential, recovery or release work.
Do not change permanent workspace layout or solid collision semantics.
Do not delete or mutate a source note when a reference node is removed.
Do not read, print or modify provider credentials.
acceptance_criteria: Reference IDs are stable record:<markId> values and reference metadata never stores the full note body.
Hover and keyboard focus open an accessible preview after 400ms with a 160ms leave delay, while drag suppresses click/open behavior.
The custom note-reference MIME is handled before generic text/JSON and placement uses one captured viewport plus collision-safe nearest-free placement.
Multiple references refresh cached title, excerpt and time in one debounced batch; missing sources retain cache and render a local missing-source state.
Double-click opens the existing right document panel record tab and deleting a reference never deletes its source.
Focused note-reference tests, Canvas tests, TypeScript and diff checks pass.
Implementation is committed and independently reviewed.
notes: Read the Task 8 brief first and use test-first implementation.
Preserve the permanent canvas and current note/document behavior.
Use fixed UTF-8 I/O for non-ASCII reads and edits.
Do not expose or change configured provider secrets.
